title: Alt+period shortcut no longer opens clipboard history

status.label: Confirm Alt+period remapping on current release
status.detail: Alt+. reportedly used to invoke Win+V but no longer works; the report says 'newest version' without an exact PowerToys or Windows version.

judgment.rationale: The reporter gives one specific shortcut, Alt+. to Win+V, and says it used to work, but does not state the PowerToys version, Windows version, keyboard layout, or whether the failure is isolated to this mapping. There are no comments or diagnostics. Current behavior and the role of the period key/left-handed layout are unclear.
evidence: The report says Alt+. previously invoked Win+V and no longer works.
The issue title is generic and the body gives no exact PowerToys version, Windows version, or keyboard layout.
The report has no comments or diagnostic attachment and is labeled for General and Keyboard Manager.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for the current PowerToys/Windows versions, keyboard layout, exact mapping direction, and whether other shortcuts still work before choosing a code path.

fix_assessment.rationale: If the exact Alt+. to Win+V mapping fails on current stable, Keyboard Manager may mishandle the punctuation-key trigger or its modifier combination. The report does not identify the active versions or establish whether other mappings fail.

proposed_fixes.title: Restore the Alt+period shortcut mapping
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The shortcut capture or dispatch path may fail to recognize the period key with Alt or may conflict with the current Windows clipboard-history shortcut. The available report does not distinguish these possibilities.
plan: Confirm the exact current PowerToys and Windows versions and active keyboard layout.
Reproduce Alt+. mapped to Win+V and compare it with another shortcut mapping.
Trace punctuation-key capture and modifier dispatch for the confirmed layout.
Correct the failing path and add a focused regression test if Keyboard Manager is at fault.
verification: Verify the configured Alt+. trigger invokes clipboard history on current stable.
Verify other shortcut mappings continue to work and the period key remains available when the mapping is disabled.

confidence.rationale: The trigger and intended action are named, but the exact versions, layout, and current behavior are not.

issue_context.summary: A left-handed reporter says Alt+. used to invoke Win+V but no longer works.
known_information: The issue body names Alt+. as the trigger and Win+V as the intended action.
The reporter says the mapping worked in an earlier version but does not give a version number.
No comments or diagnostic attachments are present.
inferences: The failure may be specific to the punctuation key or its layout, but the report does not establish whether other mappings are affected.
issue_context.analysis: Ask for the missing version/layout details and one comparison mapping before requesting diagnostics or proposing a specific code change.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue body, labels, state, and comments.
No linked fix or cross-reference was found.

information_gaps.information: Exact PowerToys and Windows versions, keyboard layout, mapping direction, and whether another shortcut mapping still works
information_gaps.why_needed: These facts distinguish a version regression, a layout-specific period-key capture issue, and a broader Keyboard Manager failure.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Report the exact versions and keyboard layout, confirm Alt+. is mapped to Win+V, and test one other shortcut mapping.

comment.body: Could you share your exact PowerToys and Windows versions and keyboard layout, and confirm whether Alt+. is mapped to Win+V? Please also test one other shortcut mapping and say whether it works. That will show whether this is specific to the period-key trigger or affects Keyboard Manager more broadly.
